The Jamie Foxx Show - I Believe I Can Fly
When Jamie's first big commercial jingle pitch for a bug spray is shot down, he e-mails a manifesto to the entire company.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Why Don't We Just Roll ... Reversal
Inspired by friends' success, Jamie and Fancy engage in a relationship-building role-playing exercise which goes awry.
The Jamie Foxx Show - The Ugly Truth
Jamie is incredulous when he loses some of his luster as a jingle writer to a good-looking new employee.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Homie, Lover, Friend
Jamie (Jamie Foxx) is alarmed when Fancy's (Garcelle Beauvais) old boyfriend (guest star Thomas Mikal Ford) puts the moves on her.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Give Me Some Credit
Jamie (Jamie Foxx) must prove his love for Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) when her well-to-do parents (guest stars Billy Davis Jr. and Marilyn McCoo) come to town.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Liar, Liar, Pants on Fire
Jamie is afraid of Fancy's reaction when he secretly woos the company's top client, a beautiful young woman.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Joy Ride

Jamie (Jamie Foxx) accepts delivery of Fancy's (Garcelle Beauvais) new BMW convertible and takes it out for a spin with his friends (guest stars Alex Thomas, Chris Spencer, Vibe and Suli McCullough). Traci Bingham also guest stars.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Get Up, Stand Up
Jamie (Jamie Foxx) encourages Fancy (Garcelle Beauvais) to stand up for herself when she is pressured into throwing a bridal shower.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Super Ego
Jamie challenges NFL players Lawrence Taylor, Charles Woodson and other pros to a game of flag football.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Family Business
Jamie bills Junior and Helen for services rendered after writing a jingle for a King's Tower TV commercial.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Friendly Fire
Jamie gets promoted into a management position, but his excitement dies when the boss orders him to fire a friend.
The Jamie Foxx Show - Home Suite Home
Jamie (Jamie Foxx) feels oppressed by Fancy's (Garcelle Beauvais) decorative touches after he moves into a penthouse apartment.
The Challenge - Welcome to the Challenge

The newly formed pairs of Challenge Vets and New Threats must put their partnership to the test immediately; a rivalry causes chaos and uncertainty, leading to drama-filled nominations; a nail-biting elimination sends shockwave.
The Challenge - We Used to Hook Up

TJ throws a huge wrench in the players' plans, making an ever-changing game even more difficult; two challengers get hot and heavy, making another begin to boil over with jealousy; the elimination sees the first head banger.
The Challenge - I Am The Challenge

One player's game is at risk, while their partner's competitiveness rears its ugly head and wishes it hadn't. The challenge tests the players' swimming skills for the first time and an added element makes some of the veterans lo.
The Challenge - Wish I'd Been Practicing

The stakes are sky-high, as one veteran shocks the house by getting last in the challenge; Hangnail, Gabe, looks to make a high-risk move to earn back some favor; the challenge tests the players' sense of direction and Sudoku.
The Challenge - Pride Comes Before the Fall

The rivalry between vets and new threats heats up; worlds collide when the sports-horror movie HIM from Director Jordan Peele gets in on the action; a new threat is taken off guard when the challenge loser wants to swing big and take them out.
The Challenge - Is He Throwing It?

A major player in the game becomes the public enemy after it appears they were trying to throw the challenge; the nominations expose where one player stands in the game and baffles another whose plan backfired.
Ink Master - Pick Your Side
Three skilled Ink Masters return for a challenge; instead of battling alone, they'll coach teams of the nation's top tattoo artists.
Ink Master - Fill'er Up
The competition is fierce and the Masters coach their team in the season's first flash challenge; some artists find their way in the elimination tattoo, but one hits a dead end and is sent packing.
Ink Master - Divine Proportion
The Masters face off to ensure the survival of their team; proportion skills are put to the test when the artists tattoo Greek deities.
Ink Master - Step It Up
The coaches step in during a team flash challenge; the artists' ingenuity is tested with mash-up tattoos.
Ink Master - Ink on the Dotted Line
Precision skills are put to the test when the artists must create masterpieces with hole punches; one of the coaches may put his own skin on the line.
Ink Master - Chin Up
The coaches must lead by example when they're forced to tattoo the underchin in a Master's Faceoff; the artists' adaptability is tested with undead tattoos.
Ink Master - Eye of the Tiger
Team dynamics are put to the test when a tag team challenge shakes the competition to its core; the coaches must make a difficult decision as the battle continues for the title.
Ink Master - Pane in the Glass
Teamwork is essential in a glass painting Flash Challenge testing dimension; artists create stone tattoos in the Elimination Tattoo and one cracks under the pressure; the rest keep fighting.
Ink Master - Ink Raider
The devil is in the details when the artists must tattoo intricate technicolor hot air balloons; the battle is heating up for the title.
Ink Master - Some Assembly Required
Teamwork is the name of the game in a series of Tag Team Tattoo Challenges; a twist forces one team's artists to turn on their own.
Ink Master - Quit Buggin' Me
The smaller the tattoo, the harder the coaches might fall in a micro Masters Face Off; in the Elimination Tattoo, one artist takes a blow to the chest and is sent packing.
Ink Master - Total Meltdown
The competition gets heated up when the artists test composition using melted wax.
Ink Master - Monkey See, Monkey Do
The stakes are higher than ever when the artists match the designs of their coaches; in a freehand face off, one artist falls out of the competition for good.
Ink Master - No Stain, No Gain
One team leaves their mark on a wood-staining flash challenge that tests contrast; one artist packs their machine and leaves the competition for good.
Ink Master - Final Exam
With a spot in the final three on the line, the artists push themselves to the limit in a grueling tattoo challenge; the masters must also fight to gain their own advantage for the finale.
Ink Master - Return of the Masters Finale
The top three artists reveal their 24-hour battle royale chest tattoos; the eliminated artists return to confront each other for the first time; one artist and master are crowned winners.
Jersey Shore Family Vacation - The Double Book

Desperate times call for desperate measures and the guys are ready for a family vacation; there's a surprise to get the girls back together, but Deena has a surprise of her own that could complicate everything.
